phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: قواعد پایه عامل‌ها
purpose: Write canonical cross-agent instructions. Insist on evidence, architecture boundaries, package ownership, minimal changes, no fake tests, no forced deployment. Refer to the baseline documents, stable P/B identifiers, and publishing controls.
acceptance: An agent asked to bypass the contract must be instructed to halt and propose an ADR; no contradictory rule files.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: قواعد جداسازی بسته‌ها
purpose: Monolith modular boundaries; APIs/events only; foreign/domestic physical separation; no direct DB cross-package writes.
acceptance: Valid Cursor MDC frontmatter with appropriate alwaysApply/globs; aligned to AGENTS.md.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: قواعد قراردادها
purpose: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12, frozen v1.0, examples, idempotency, versioning, breaking changes only through ADR.
acceptance: Valid Cursor MDC frontmatter with appropriate alwaysApply/globs; aligned to AGENTS.md.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: قواعد امنیت و محرمانگی
purpose: No real secrets; authentication and authorization in backend, private_report never publishable, scoped accounts; audit.
acceptance: Valid Cursor MDC frontmatter with appropriate alwaysApply/globs; aligned to AGENTS.md.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: قواعد سیستم طراحی اعتماد
purpose: React TS, shadcn/ui, Tailwind v4, RTL, token standards, accessible states; explicitly supersede prior Mantine reference.
acceptance: Valid Cursor MDC frontmatter with appropriate alwaysApply/globs; aligned to AGENTS.md.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: قواعد شواهد آزمون
purpose: Run applicable tests, capture commands/logs, report not-run/blocked separately; negative and failure tests.
acceptance: Valid Cursor MDC frontmatter with appropriate alwaysApply/globs; aligned to AGENTS.md.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: قواعد Cloud Agent
purpose: Allowed-file scopes, branch isolation, no shared migration commits, PR with logs, refrain from deploying production.
acceptance: Valid Cursor MDC frontmatter with appropriate alwaysApply/globs; aligned to AGENTS.md.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: معماری و مرزبندی
purpose: Freeze 6 conceptual layers, 9 dev packages B01-B09, 29 project IDs, modular central core + separate domestic/foreign ingest.
acceptance: ADR shows status, context, decision, consequences, impacted contracts and unanswered external dependencies.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: تغییر فناوری UI
purpose: Resolve Mantine conflict: React+TS+shadcn/ui+Tailwind4+React Aria as needed, DTCG tokens, Tiptap, TanStack. Keep brand colors pending official assets.
acceptance: ADR shows status, context, decision, consequences, impacted contracts and unanswered external dependencies.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: مالکیت پایگاه داده
purpose: Define central/domestic/foreign PostgreSQL, separate Redis queues, S3-like object storage; 41 proposals not final DDL; schema ownership rules.
acceptance: ADR shows status, context, decision, consequences, impacted contracts and unanswered external dependencies.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: دروازه انتشار
purpose: Approval & copyright rights gates; explicit switches; destination adapters only with verified official API; private reports structurally excluded.
acceptance: ADR shows status, context, decision, consequences, impacted contracts and unanswered external dependencies.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: حساب‌ها و نقش‌ها
purpose: Max 10 active humans; owner & EIC separated dashboards; individual random initial credentials reset required, secure issuance, strong MFA for privileged.
acceptance: ADR shows status, context, decision, consequences, impacted contracts and unanswered external dependencies.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: درگاه مدل‌های قابل تعویض
purpose: Model provider adapters, fallback, timeouts, budgets, provenance, logs without secret/personal data; no provider hardcoding.
acceptance: ADR shows status, context, decision, consequences, impacted contracts and unanswered external dependencies.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: فهرست ارتباطات و مرزها
purpose: Normalize authoritative project_package_map.csv and dependency_edges.csv into a readable source-linked dependency register; do not invent edges.
acceptance: All 29 P IDs represented; cross-package dependencies and input/output present.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: مالک هر قرارداد
purpose: Map 30 JSON Schemas and corresponding examples to producing/consuming projects and proposed table owner; identify unresolved mappings.
acceptance: Every schema classified; unresolved ownership clearly marked; no silent schema edits.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: مرور طرح دیتابیس
purpose: Review 41 proposed tables and 3 SQL draft files; identify ownership collisions and unsafe defaults; produce proposed migration plan not production DDL.
acceptance: No unapproved SQL applied; all 3 DB environments addressed.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: ابزار اعتبارسنجی قراردادهای نسخه صفر
purpose: Read schemas and example records from source/contracts; validate all with installed jsonschema; detailed pass/fail, exit nonzero on violations.
acceptance: All 30 examples must be validated (or exact errors reported) without modifying reference contracts.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: آزمون قراردادی CI
purpose: Define offline CI to install minimal deps, validate schemas/examples, lint changed JSON and Markdown path references.
acceptance: Dry-run locally or give exact unverified status; CI must fail on invalid JSON/schema.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: وابستگی‌های پایتون
purpose: Minimal pinned/reproducible Python dependencies for FastAPI, Pydantic, Postgres, Redis, tests; distinguish runtime and dev groups.
acceptance: Install plan works on supported Python 3.11+; no unverifiable or unneeded dependencies.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: وابستگی‌های رابط
purpose: React/TypeScript, build/test scripts, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui compatible setup; no Mantine.
acceptance: Package scripts and versions checked against available official dependencies; no duplicate UI library.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: راهنمای ریشه مخزن
purpose: Project overview, non-operational status until validated, package map, how to read source specs, local workflow and mock-only defaults.
acceptance: A new developer can find contracts, tasks and run local tests; no deployment secrets.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: گیت‌ایگنور محرمانگی
purpose: Ignore .env, credentials, caches, local media, generated passwords, database dumps, build outputs but keep safe env.example and all source schemas.
acceptance: No real secrets or outputs accidentally tracked.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: تنظیمات یکسان ویرایش
purpose: Shared text encodings, LF/CRLF handling, indent conventions for Python, TypeScript, Markdown and Persian.
acceptance: Python and TS files retain consistent formatting across Windows/Cloud.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: مالکیت تغییرات
purpose: Review paths for core/contracts, 9 packages and deployment with named teams placeholders (not fabricated GitHub users).
acceptance: No invented usernames; review owners can be set when GitHub team identifiers known.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: ممیزی وابستگی بین بسته‌ها
purpose: Static import/path inspection to flag banned cross-package internals and forbidden direct DB connection strings; report false-positive limitations.
acceptance: Exit nonzero for fixture violations, no speculative AST enforcement claims.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: پیکربندی تایپ‌اسکریپت
purpose: Strict TypeScript, JSX, path aliases aligned with Vite, no skip of critical type checking.
acceptance: TS project builds and invalid types fail.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: پیکربندی Vite
purpose: React build, shared path aliases, safe development proxy and no unverified plugin dependencies.
acceptance: npm build on local install or exact NOT_RUN; no secrets embedded.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: سند ریشه وب
purpose: RTL Persian HTML, correct language/title, accessible app root, no invented newspaper logo.
acceptance: HTML parses and no external unsafe resource dependencies.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: ورود React
purpose: Mount React app, error boundary/provider shell and styles without duplicating business logic.
acceptance: React renders after providers implemented; no global secret.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: پیکربندی shadcn/ui
purpose: Configure shadcn/ui project paths, CSS/Tailwind v4 and icon approach, mark version required verification.
acceptance: shadcn generator recognizes config in actual installed version; no Mantine.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: بازبینی lint فرانت
purpose: Current ESLint/TS/React hooks rules and scripts matching package.json.
acceptance: Lint rejects unused vars/unsafe patterns; versions confirmed against lockfile.

phase_title: مرحله صفر: قفل قرارداد و قوانین
title: پیکربندی آزمون مرورگر
purpose: Stable Playwright desktop/mobile emulation, screenshots and reduced-motion option with mock network.
acceptance: Playwright starts in CI or provides exact install blockers.

title: ورود به API
purpose: Create FastAPI app composition with only explicit routers, health, secure error handler and no import-side-effects.
acceptance: App imports without DB connection or network; OpenAPI accessible only as configured.

title: مصرف قراردادها
purpose: Read versioned schemas and validate payloads at boundaries; report typed errors and prohibit silent coercion.
acceptance: Valid examples pass; broken schemas and wrong versions fail.

title: تنظیمات نسخه‌دار
purpose: Store scoped config revisions and optimistic concurrency with audit; redact credentials.
acceptance: Conflicting expected_revision returns 409; unauthorized update 403.

title: سه کلید مستقل خروجی
purpose: Implement backend gating for public_analysis, studio(audio/video) and publishing(domestic/foreign/public_reports); recheck before side effects.
acceptance: Off switch blocks new work and dispatch; read/archive and private reports continue; held jobs need expiry recheck.

title: دفتر منابع
purpose: Versioned source registry with rights scope, feeds, countries and stream separation; approved candidate imports only.
acceptance: No foreign source mistakenly active in domestic scheduler; unapproved country candidates remain inactive.

title: احراز هویت
purpose: Secure password hashing, individual bootstrap random passwords, reset-on-first-login, session expiration, no shared default password.
acceptance: Invalid password denied; initial plaintext never logged; max 10 active human accounts enforced.

title: کنترل دسترسی RBAC
purpose: Server-side resource ACL for owner, editor-in-chief, staff; private reports EIC only by default per baseline.
acceptance: Unauthorized direct endpoint/search/job/artifact returns 403/404 even if UI route hidden.

title: لاگ ممیزی
purpose: Append-only audit event service, redaction, actor/correlation ID, role-safe retrieval.
acceptance: Switch edits, publications, private-report reads and account changes produce auditable records.

title: مرجع محرمانه
purpose: Resolve credential_ref from secret store via injected interface; never store actual secrets in DB/event/UI.
acceptance: Missing/unauthorized secret fail closed; tests never write credential content to logs.

title: ثبت آرشیو و نسخه‌ها
purpose: Archive original immutable material, derived revisions, source evidence, visibility and secure artifact indexes.
acceptance: Same news_id upsert idempotent, original preserved, private access enforced.

title: پوش رویدادها
purpose: Event envelope and correlation/idempotency identifiers; minimal message payloads with artifact refs.
acceptance: Duplicate event safe and version validated; no secret/private payload on public topic.

title: مدیریت کارها
purpose: Durable job lifecycle, leases, bounded retries/dead-letter, stream isolation and status timestamps.
acceptance: Restart-safe retry & dedup; failed job reason is inspectable without sensitive text.

title: تراکنش و Outbox
purpose: Transactional outbox same DB transaction as authoritative data change; at-least-once delivery with consumers idempotent.
acceptance: Failure between commit/publish does not lose event; duplicate delivery not duplicate side effect.

title: گردش کار
purpose: Route jobs by declared events without embedding business logic; consult output switches before new work.
acceptance: No cross-package import of internal business logic; failures isolated and observable.

title: درگاه چندمدلی
purpose: Provider-neutral interface, timeouts, retries, cost caps, model provenance; no provider-specific core coupling.
acceptance: Mock two providers in tests; fallback only when policy permits; cost and model ID preserved.

title: پایگاه مرکزی
purpose: Central Postgres connection/session boundaries, transactional scope and typed config; no hard-coded DSN.
acceptance: Unit tests can inject fake DB; separate domestic/foreign DSNs never opened here.

title: فایل‌ها در مخزن شیء
purpose: Scoped access to large media/raw originals with checksums and visibility policy; references only in events.
acceptance: Signed retrieval expires and respects visibility; checksums checked.

title: مهاجرت پایه هسته
purpose: Translate reviewed conceptual SQL into a validated Alembic migration after schema audit and ownership review; no destructive guessing.
acceptance: Upgrade/downgrade tested against disposable Postgres; constraints and indexes inspected.

title: آزمون قراردادها
purpose: Automated all 30 schema examples and invalid fixtures, evaluate semantic mismatch risks.
acceptance: Suite exits nonzero for invalid contract; testing result must be reported.

title: آزمون منفی امنیت
purpose: Test auth/rbac/direct URL/private-report; brute-force safeguards, secret redaction, admin rotation.
acceptance: Staff cannot see executive-private even by guessed ID or search; owner privileges explicitly scoped.

acceptance: Screenshots/logs from actual test run; mock backend clearly identified.

title: CI بک‌اند
purpose: Install/run lint/type/pytest/contract tests with least privileges and no prod secrets.
acceptance: Fails on regressions and saves test summary.

title: CI فرانت
purpose: Build TS, lint, unit and UI tests (browser setup if needed), artifact logs.
acceptance: No pass claims without GitHub workflow run.

title: CI امنیت
purpose: Dependency audit and secret checks and backend auth tests with documented thresholds and exceptions.
acceptance: No secret or risky dependency silently accepted.

title: تنظیم محیط آزمون UI
purpose: Shared test fixtures, mock API, roles and reset state; no live external publishing.
acceptance: Playwright suites run deterministically or report actual prereq failures.

title: تحویل فایل‌های وب
purpose: Secure static frontend serving, SPA fallback, headers/CSP proposal and private API proxy boundary.
acceptance: No sensitive assets public; server config syntax checked or marked unverified.

title: راهنمای سه محیط اجرا
purpose: Document isolated compose files, network, prerequisites, TLS, secrets and startup order with no real keys.
acceptance: Operator knows what is not deployed and can test network isolation in staging.

title: قرارداد API پیاده‌شده
purpose: Export actual FastAPI-generated OpenAPI spec after API implementation; do not synthesize 34 planned endpoints as completed.
acceptance: Paths/schema responses match tested server; gaps separately listed in review.

title: معیار نسخه آزمایشی و عملیاتی
purpose: Define v0 demo vs staging vs production gates: sources, permissions, media rights, output controls, restore, legal signoff and CMS unknown blocker.
acceptance: A single failed critical gate blocks production; no fabricated readiness.

title: ثبت تغییرات
purpose: Versioned changes by package and schema with links to PR/tests.
acceptance: Every release note points to tested evidence or blocked status.

title: راهنمای تحویل تیم‌ها
purpose: Instructions for B01-B09 owners: contract version, deployment boundaries, tests, unanswered decisions, support/ownership.
acceptance: All nine package handoffs are distinguishable and reproducible.

title: پذیرش کارفرما
purpose: Prepare formal acceptance report with 29 rows, proof links, blockers, costs, model API state, CMS and branding assets gaps.
acceptance: Cannot say complete until all criteria met with logs and signoff.

title: تغییرات پرامپت‌ها
purpose: Track per-task original model, version, edits, approval and scope changes; protect Prompt Guard constraints.
acceptance: Every change traceable to a task/PR.

title: معماری آنچه واقعاً ساخته شده
purpose: Compare actual verified repo/modules/test gates against 6-layer/9-package/29-project baseline; mark absent, partial and completed separately.
acceptance: Every claimed implementation backed by file/PR/test evidence, not document existence.
